A non-bailable warrant has reportedly been issued against YouTuber Dhruv Rathee in connection with a defamation case. The legal action has brought fresh attention to the controversy surrounding his alleged remarks. But what exactly did Dhruv Rathee say, who filed the defamation complaint, and what allegations have been made against him? Why has the court taken such a strict step, and what could happen next? In this video, we break down the complete case, the allegations, the court proceedings, and the legal implications of the non bailable warrant.
